name: Root-Cause Repair
description: Reproduction-first debugging that distinguishes causes from symptom suppressors.

tasks.name: Reproduce failure
tasks.objective: Capture the smallest reliable failing case, exact inputs/state/environment, expected behavior, actual behavior, logs/traces, frequency, and boundaries where the failure disappears.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A failure can be reproduced or its non-reproducibility is itself documented with evidence.

tasks.name: Trace causal path
tasks.objective: Follow the failing value/state/event backward through callers, representation boundaries, transforms, caches, concurrency, lifetime, persistence, and external contracts. Maintain multiple hypotheses and seek evidence that distinguishes them.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Leading hypothesis explains both failure and known non-failing cases.

tasks.name: Encode regression
tasks.objective: Create a test or executable reproduction that fails for the observed defect and would still fail if a cosmetic clamp, retry, or log suppression merely hid the symptom.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The regression demonstrably fails before the fix.

tasks.name: Repair the cause
tasks.objective: Change the earliest appropriate source of incorrect state or behavior. Avoid broad rewrites unless the causal model proves local repair cannot restore the invariant.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The fix restores the violated invariant rather than muting its evidence.

tasks.name: Falsify the repair
tasks.objective: Run regression plus adjacent tests, boundary cases, failure-path tests, and targeted search for equivalent code paths. Try to recreate the bug through alternate inputs and ordering.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Regression passes and alternate paths do not reproduce the original failure.
No unrelated behavior was changed without justification.

tasks.name: Close diagnostic loop
tasks.objective: Document root cause, triggering conditions, fix mechanism, tests added, affected versions/surfaces, residual risk, and why rejected hypotheses were rejected.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The explanation predicts the observed failure and successful repair.
